title: The Normal Domination Partizan Game in Stars
summary: The Domination game is an impartial game on graphs, introduced in 2010, and proved PSPACE-complete in the normal variant in 2026. In this game, Alice and Bob alternately select playable vertices, where a vertex is playable if it dominates at least one vertex not dominated by the vertices selected before in the game. The game ends when the selected vertices form a dominating set. In the normal variant, the player unable to move loses.
